headline: Adani Defence & Aerospace wins SIDM Champion Award 2026
hook: Recognised for international defence export performance
summary: Adani Defence & Aerospace has been awarded the SIDM Champion Award 2026 for its performance in defence exports. The company manufactures small-calibre ammunition for defence and law enforcement clients globally. This recognition highlights the growing footprint of private Indian firms in the international defence manufacturing sector. Retail investors tracking the defence theme can note the expanding global order books of private players.
why_it_matters: Private defence exporters gain validation for global market expansion.

headline: GQG Partners trims stake in Adani Group companies
hook: Key Adani backer reduces group exposure

The move by a prominent institutional backer has contributed to recent downward pressure on the group's share prices. Retail investors should note that institutional selling often influences market sentiment and volatility for these stocks.
why_it_matters: Institutional selling may increase volatility for Adani group stocks.

headline: Indian markets extend sell-off as RBI policy weighs on sentiment
hook: Nifty drops 1.64% on hawkish RBI stance
summary: The Nifty 50 fell 1.64% to 22,231.80, while the Sensex declined 1.46% to 71,593.24 on Thursday. The sell-off was driven by the RBI's hawkish policy stance, which negatively impacted rate-sensitive sectors. Metals and realty stocks led the decline across the indices. Infosys, Tech Mahindra, Adani Enterprises, and ITC were among the notable movers during the session.
why_it_matters: Rate-sensitive stocks face valuation resets due to RBI policy.
winners_losers: IT stocks gain / Metals and Realty hurt
